summary: Short retest of the KHQR follow-up fixes. Unit (6/6 new + 9/9 iter15 regression): M.KHMER no longer matches '15,000៛' or Khmer digits but still matches Khmer letters. M.speak sends Khmer text to voxcpm2-hf and English text with ៛ to openai (hf_voxcpm and TTS were monkeypatched). PAID_MSG is English when the English user message contains ៛ and Khmer for a Khmer message. handle_incoming with a mocked LLM reply 'Your total is $2.5 + 15,000៛ [[order:...]]' gets the English QR_FAIL line and a Khmer reply gets the Khmer one, with no order created. Order numbers match RF-[0-9A-F]{8}. Live (7/7 assertions): unique index business_id_1_number_1 exists. Widget 'I want to buy 2 Iced Palm Sugar Latte' gives a pending $5.00 khqr (RF-8hex), and mark-paid sends the 'Payment received' message. An English KHR order with '15,000៛' in the message, once marked paid, gets the ENGLISH 'Payment received' message. Prompt rule sampled on 4 live replies (2 mixed USD+KHR, 2 range '10-15$'): no QR is sent and the fallback line is English, BUT the AI still claimed a QR was being sent in 4/4 replies (100%). UI: Orders page: an expired order needs 2 clicks (text changes to 'Really received? Click again' and reverts after about 4 s, the 2nd click marks it paid). A pending order is marked paid in 1 click. Inbox KHQR card on a cancelled order: the 1st click shows the confirm text, the 2nd click marks it paid, the card shows 'Paid — thank you!' and the Payment received message appears.

minor.issue: Prompt rule is ignored 4/4 times. Mixed carts: 'Your total is $17.50. I'm sending you a Bakong KHQR code now' (the total is also wrong: it should be $2.5 + 15,000៛), and 'Your total is $35,000៛ ($5 + 30,000៛). A Bakong KHQR code is on its way'. Range: 'That's 10-15$ ... I'll send you a Bakong KHQR payment QR now', and '2 TEST Mystery Box for $20-30 total. I'm sending you a Bakong KHQR code now'. Each reply then ends with the English QR_FAIL line, which contradicts it.

action_items: A prompt-only rule does not stop the model from promising a QR. Enforce it in code. Options: (a) in catalog_text, tag products whose price P.parse_price can't parse as 'no QR — team confirms price' and list each product's currency; (b) better: in handle_incoming, when items exist but create_order fails on a price/currency problem, drop the model's QR sentences or regenerate once with a system note ('order can't be created: mixed currency / price range — ask to order separately / say team confirms price'), and use a specific fallback line instead of 'could not be created right now'.
critical_code_review_comments: create_order: insert_one with the new unique (business_id, number) index raises DuplicateKeyError on a collision (negligible with 8 hex chars), and that would surface as an AI reply failure. Consider one retry.
create_order returns None for both 'bad price/currency' and 'relay down', so the fallback text can't tell them apart ('right now' is misleading for a range price).

success_rate.backend: 100% of fix checks (22/22: 6 unit + 9 iter15 unit regression + 7 live); prompt rule behaviour 0/4
